title: Klint Kubiak: Brock Bowers is a football robot from heaven

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Klint Kubiak: Brock Bowers is a football robot from heaven
sources.description: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak hasn't been in his job long, but he's been in it long enough to know who one of the cornerstones of his team will be this season.
